designs.title: No.
designs.why: I got the joke right away and smiled: a grumpy cat lying on the word NO and pawing the full stop like a toy ball is exactly how cats act. The face is great, with a perfect unimpressed side-eye, and the line work is clean and confident. It reads clearly from across a room on both the white and the black tee, and the black version looks especially sharp. Small gripes: the stripes inside the letters are a bit busy next to the hatched tail, and on the tee the print feels a little small and high for a $50 shirt.
designs.fix: Print it about 15-20% bigger and a touch lower on the chest/back, so it feels like a statement piece worth $50 and not a small badge.
